The *Dutiyapalāyitajātaka* (Ja 230), titled *The Fleer (2nd)*, is a narrative text preserved within the Pali Jātaka collection [SuttaCentral]. According to its traditional opening context, the Buddha related this account while staying at Jetavana concerning a wandering or "gadabout" mendicant, beginning with the opening verse words: "Countless are my banners" [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations of the text across four languages [SuttaCentral].
